title: Choose Spindle's Visual Direction
question: The roll assigned Sunlit Home Sanctuary for Spindle's overhaul. Keep it, choose an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Sunlit Home Sanctuary
options.lineage: Philippine daylight residential interiors & precision utility
options.thesis: Warm stone surfaces meet crisp booking slots so home repair feels calm, plain-spoken, and trustworthy.
options.viewport: Clean top bar over a daylight hero with an interactive Appliance & 2-Hour Window picker, leading into illustrated appliance tiles and local hubs.
options.risk: Could feel understated if spacing rhythm and interactive widget craft are softened.

raised.raise: Progressive disclosure keeps every page clean at rest and moves details into sub-pages and drawers.
Unbroken surface flow eliminates nested card-inside-card clutter.
Clear focal framing gives every appliance type and status stage instant mobile scanability.

options.label: Tactile Service Passbook
options.lineage: Household appliance care booklets & stamped appointment slips
options.thesis: Every appliance and visit reads like a clean, durable household care passbook with stamped 2-hour windows.
options.viewport: Clear offer beside a stamped service passbook card showing the next available 2-hour home visit slots.
options.risk: Closest to familiar service-booking layouts in the home-care category.

options.label: Stitched Care Shelf
options.lineage: Tooled saddle headers, warm linen ground & walnut shelf cards
options.thesis: Registered appliances and bookings sit like physical household care manuals on warm domestic shelves.
options.viewport: Warm linen canvas with stitched care tabs and tactile raised appliance cards.
options.case: Strong domestic warmth and tactile clarity, though heavy textures can crowd technician and admin tables.
options.risk: Reads vintage rather than modern for smart inverter appliances.

options.label: Amber Station Sequence
options.lineage: Timed bay progression under warm amber safelight
options.thesis: Repairs move through four crisp numbered stations in order—Book, Confirm, Visit, Settle—with unmistakable stage focus.
options.viewport: Deep amber-lit opening staging the four repair visit stations across the first viewport.
options.case: Unmatched step clarity for tracking repairs, though darkroom lighting feels less natural for daytime home booking.
options.risk: Dark amber palette may feel heavy for casual household visitors.

options.label: Rubber-Hose Cel
options.lineage: Early sound-era animation cels & circular iris vignettes
options.thesis: Appliances bounce inside circular ink vignettes across a gray wash stage.
options.viewport: Circular iris opening over cartoon appliance silhouettes.
options.case: Cartoon aesthetic undermines homeowner trust when inviting a technician into their home.
options.risk: Playful gag framing clashes with reliable repair care.
options.kept: Unmistakable focal framing for each appliance type.

options.label: Fluid Ink Basin
options.thesis: Service sections drift across swirling liquid ink currents.
options.viewport: Marbled ink current flowing behind minimal booking actions.
options.case: Fluid motion obscures structured scheduling and adds heavy mobile GPU cost.
options.risk: Distracts from clear slot booking and pricing.
options.kept: Continuous surface flow without nested box clutter.

options.label: Drawcord Transforming Silk
options.lineage: Tailored matte black silk with gold drawcord channels
options.thesis: Pulling gold cord lines gathers flat rows into layered pleated panels.
options.viewport: Dark pleated panel with gold cord controls.
options.case: High-fashion textile language feels disconnected from household appliance care.
options.risk: Confusing metaphor for homeowners booking repairs.
options.kept: Progressive disclosure—compact at rest, detailed on demand.

options.label: Hand-Processed 16mm Film
options.lineage: Scratched silver emulsion strips with amber light leaks
options.thesis: Repair milestones appear as frames along a sprocketed film strip.
options.viewport: Sprocket-margined horizontal frames over dark film leader.
options.case: Scratches and chemical grain evoke damage rather than dependable repair.
options.risk: Hurts clarity and legibility on phones.

canonCard.label: Precision Cobalt Standard
canonCard.thesis: Clean white & slate grid with cobalt actions, executed at full craft.
canonCard.viewport: Split hero over light gray canvas with clean feature row.
canonCard.risk: Matches standard SaaS and home-service marketplaces.
